regions.text: 間に因果性以外の開係の存在することを癒極師に目撃する場合とがあるがいづれの場合にあつても因果性の否定といふ點においては愛りない。

quote.translation: In causal contingency there is the case in which, with regard to a single event, we witness negatively the non-existence of causality, and the case in which, between two or more events, we witness positively the existence of a relation other than causality; in either case it is equally the negation of causality.

regions.text: 同様に目的々偶然にあつても一つの事象について目的の非存在を酒極脚に把握する場合と、二つ或は二つ以上の事象間に目釣以外の開係の存在することを衝榔脚に把握する場合とがあつてしかもいづれの場合にも目的性の否定といふ共通話を有つてるる。

quote.translation: Teleological contingency likewise includes the case in which, with regard to a single event, we grasp negatively the non-existence of purpose, and the case in which, between two or more events, we grasp positively the existence of a relation other than purpose, and both cases have in common the negation of purposiveness.

regions.text: 要するに因果的消極的偶然因果前積極的個然日前々滔極前然目的々積極的偶然の四種が存在するのである。

quote.translation: There exist, in short, four kinds: negative causal contingency, positive causal contingency, negative teleological contingency and positive teleological contingency.

regions.text: 曩に取扱つた理由約滑極的個然理由的積極的偶然の二種を加へて、假説的偶然には六種の偶然性が考へられるわけである。假說的偶然經驗肉們然

quote.translation: If we add the two kinds already treated, negative contingency of ground and positive contingency of ground, six kinds of contingency are to be considered within hypothetical contingency.
